items.a: AgroTwin is a Digital Twin and AI-powered Agriculture Platform that helps producers and organizations digitize, monitor and optimize orchard production — combining mapping, records, satellite indicators and AI agronomic assistance.
Individual orchard owners and agricultural producers, as well as enterprise organizations such as agricultural companies, cooperatives, buyers and groups that manage networks of growers.
Yes. The platform supports organizing production areas and orchard information. Larger multi-farm and multi-producer setups are typically handled through enterprise configuration.

items.q: What is a Digital Orchard Twin?
items.a: A digital representation of your orchard: boundaries, rows, tree positions, varieties and related production records kept in one organized environment.

AgroTwin uses satellite-based vegetation indicators such as NDVI, NDWI and NDRE to help you observe orchard conditions over time. Indicators and anomaly signals support decisions — they are not confirmed agronomic diagnoses.

items.q: What can the AI Agronomist help me with?
items.a: You can ask agricultural questions in natural language and get guidance grounded in a specialized agricultural knowledge base. It is a decision-support assistant and does not replace professional agronomists.

items.q: Can AgroTwin be customized for larger agricultural companies?
items.a: Yes. Enterprise deployments can be tailored for multi-farm oversight, producer networks, reporting, integrations and organization-specific workflows.

Individual producers can choose a monthly license (€29 / month) or an annual license (€299 / year). Enterprise customers receive custom pricing based on scope. Access is provisioned through the AgroTwin application.
